entities.name: Juha Hänninen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Juha Hänninen is a Finnish politician from the National Coalition Party and former boxer. Hänninen is a member of the Parliament of Finland (MP). He was elected as a member of Finnish Parliament in April 2023 with 5251 personal votes from Oulu. He competed in the men's light heavyweight event at the 1984 Summer Olympics.

entities.summary: Juha Hänninen is a Finnish politician from the National Coalition Party and former boxer. Hänninen is a member of the Parliament of Finland (MP). He was elected as a member of Finnish Parliament in April 2023 with 5251 personal votes from Oulu. He competed in the men's light heavyweight event at the 1984 Summer Olympics.
